name: Hung Yen Data and Digital Transformation Center
developer: Hung Yen Department of Science and Technology / provincial government
notes: Provincial decision establishes the Data and Digital Transformation Center under the Department of Science and Technology; public-sector data/digital infrastructure center, not a commercial colocation project.

name: Hung Yen eco-industrial park and data center investment proposal
developer: Undisclosed private investors / Hung Yen provincial authorities
notes: Local press reports provincial leaders worked with two businesses on proposed investments in an eco-industrial park and data center; early-stage proposal, no capacity disclosed.

name: Nam Dinh Provincial Integrated Data Center
notes: Article says important shared provincial digital services are to be managed/operated at the Nam Dinh integrated data center by 2025, with development through 2030 using government cloud, big data, and links to national/regional data centers.

name: Phu Tho Provincial Digital Data Center
notes: Provincial digital data center reported operating 24/7 for storage, processing and data connections among state agencies; capacity in MW not disclosed.

name: KCTC / ThePRECON Thai Nguyen Data Center
developer: KCTC Vietnam and ThePRECON Co., Ltd.
notes: Korean-backed investment cooperation/MOU for a Thai Nguyen data center; reported at about USD 200 million and minimum 20 MW. Status kept planned because source evidence is agreement stage.

name: Thai Nguyen Provincial Data Center
notes: Official provincial portal says Thai Nguyen launched its provincial data center on 2026-03-13; includes shared data warehouse, IOC and upgraded C-ThaiNguyen platform.

name: Vinh Phuc Provincial Data Center
notes: Provincial regulation defines and governs the Vinh Phuc provincial data center; later government article says the provincial data center and large enterprise data centers in the province are operating effectively.

name: Dien Bien Provincial Data Center
developer: Dien Bien Department of Science and Technology / provincial government
notes: Reported provincial data center operates 54 physical servers and 835 TB storage to support centralized storage and digitized records for two-level local government.

name: Dak Nong Integrated Data Center
notes: Provincial regulation covers management and operation of the Dak Nong integrated data center; later coverage says the province's digital transformation data center operates 69 virtualized servers.

name: Hau Giang Provincial Data Center
notes: Government coverage says the province was instructed to continue effective operation of its data center and shared digital platforms; Nhan Dan also notes a provincial data center using cloud technology.

name: Mekong Delta Regional Data Center
developer: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment / regional government stakeholders
notes: Vietnam News Agency photo report describes inauguration of the Mekong Delta regional data center in Can Tho, including hardware/IT infrastructure, internal software and databases for environment, agriculture and socio-economic data.

name: VDC2 Can Tho Data Center
notes: Aggregate/vendor article states VDC2 launched three large data centers, including one in Can Tho; retained as weak evidence because an official current facility page was not found.

name: Da Nang Data Center at Da Nang Hi-Tech Park
developer: Da Nang International Data Centre JSC
notes: Official city portal reports groundbreaking at Lot H4 in Da Nang Hi-Tech Park; 2 ha site, 1,000 racks, 18.5 MW IT load, TIA-942C Rated-3/Tier-3 design, with operations expected 2026-2027.

name: AIDC DeCenter Da Nang AI Data Center
notes: Government and VnExpress report launch of USD 200 million AI data center project in Da Nang Hi-Tech Park/Lien Chieu; public sources did not give a confirmed MW figure.

name: FPT Data Center Da Nang
notes: FPT's internal news site reported topping-out at F-City, Hoa Hai, Ngu Hanh Son, with completion scheduled in June 2024; contractor page lists FPT Data Center Da Nang, developer FPT Telecom, time 2024.

name: Viettel IDC Da Nang Data Center
notes: DCD reports Viettel IDC has five data centers across Hanoi, Da Nang and Ho Chi Minh City; Baxtel lists the Da Nang facility as operational since May 2014.

name: VNPT IDC An Don Da Nang
notes: Data center directories list VNPT IDC An Don in Da Nang, about 300 square meters, with over 20 Gbps connectivity; source is aggregate/directory rather than official facility page.
